# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Sherry FitzGerald is delighted to present No. 7 The Hall, Scholarstown Wood to the market. Built in 2018, this impressive four-bedroom semi-detached family home is presented in excellent condition throughout and offers spacious, well-balanced accommodation ideally suited to modern family living.

## Fakta
- Typ: semi-detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 141 m²
- Energetická náročnost: A
- Lokalita: 7 The Hall, Scholarstown Wood, Rathfarnham
- Cena: 850 000 €
